questions.q_en: 2. A right circular solid cone of radius 14.4 cm and height 32.4 cm is melted and recast into a right circular cylinder of height 43.2 cm. What is the diameter of the base of the cylinder ?
questions.q_hi: 2. एक लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकु, जिसकी त्रिज्या 14.4 सेमी तथा ऊंचाई 32.4 सेमी है, उसे पिघलाया जाता है तथा उससे एक लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन बनाया जाता है जिसकी ऊंचाई 43.2 सेमी है | इस बेलन के आधार का व्यास कितना है ?
questions.solution_en:
2.(a)

13R2H = πr2h

Here ‘R’ is the radius and ‘H’ is the height of the cone, ‘r’ is the radius and ‘h’ is the height of the cylinder.

13 × π × R2 × H = π × r2 × h⇒ 13 × 14.42 × 32.4 = r2 × 43.2⇒  r = 7.2

Diameter of the cylinder = 2 × 7.2 = 14.4 cm

13R2H = πr2h

बेलन का व्यास = 2 × 7.2 = 14.4 cm

questions.q_en: 10. If 2sinθ + 15cos²θ = 7, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of tanθ + cosθ + secθ is :
questions.q_hi: 10. यदि 2sinθ + 15cos²θ = 7, 0° < θ < 90° है, तो tanθ + cosθ + secθ का मान ज्ञात करें |
questions.solution_en:
10.(b)

2sinθ + 15cos²θ = 7, 0° < θ < 90°

 ⇒ 2sinθ + 15(1 - sin²θ) = 7

 ⇒ 15 sin²θ - 2sinθ - 8 = 0

⇒ 15 sin²θ - 12sinθ + 10 sinθ - 8 = 0

⇒ sinθ = 45 or -23

As θ is between 0° and 90°, sinθ will be positive.

Cosθ = 35, tanθ = 43 and secθ = 53

Put values in: tanθ + cosθ + secθ

We get; 43 + 35 + 53 = 335

questions.q_en: 11. Find the equation of the line passing through the point (2,3) and perpendicular to the line 3x + 2y − 1 = 0 .
questions.q_hi: 11. बिंदु (2,3) से गुजरने वाली और रेखा 3x + 2y − 1 = 0 के लंबवत रेखा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए |
options_hi:
x − 3y + 5 = 0

2x − y + 5 = 0

2x − 3y + 5 = 0

3x − 2y + 5 = 0
questions.solution_en:
11.(c)

The line 3x + 2y = 1 is of the form ax + by = c

⇒ slope = -ab = -32

∴ slope of the line perpendicular to the line passing through (2,3) is = 23

∴ equation of line passing through (2,3) is

⇒ (y − 3) = 23(x − 2)

⇒ 3y − 9 = 2x − 4

⇒ 2x − 3y + 5 = 0
questions.solution_hi:

रेखा 3x + 2y = 1, ax +  by = c के रूप की है,

⇒ ढलान (slope ) = -ab = -32

∴ (2,3) से गुजरने वाली रेखा का समीकरण है

⇒ (y − 3) = 23(x − 2)

⇒ 3y − 9 = 2x − 4

⇒ 2x − 3y + 5 = 0

questions.q_en: 19. A shopkeeper marked up the price of gold rings by 40% and he sold only 40% of these at this price. He sells half of the rest at 14.28% discount and the rest at 25% discount. What is the overall profit?
questions.q_hi: 19. एक दुकानदार ने सोने की अंगूठियों की कीमत 40% अधिक रखी तथा केवल 40% अंगूठियों को ही इस कीमत पर बेच पाया | शेष अंगूठियों में से आधी को उसने 14.28% की छूट पर बेचा तथा शेष अंगूठियों को 25% की छूट पर बेच दिया | कुल मिलाकर उसे कितना लाभ हुआ ?
questions.solution_en:
19.(a)

Let the cost price of each ring = Rs. 1

Let the no of rings = 10

Total cost price of rings = Rs.10

Marked up the price 40% above the cost price

So marked price of each ring = Rs.1.4

40% sell on the marked price

So selling price of 4 ring = 1.4 × 4 = Rs. 5.6

After than he gives discount of 14.28% on half of the rest rings

So selling price of 3 rings = 3 × 1.2 = Rs. 3.6

Again, he gives discount of 25% on remaining

So selling price of 3 rings = 3 × 1.05 = Rs. 3.15

Total selling price = 5.6 + 3.6 + 3.15 = Rs. 12.35

Profit = 12.35-10 = Rs. 2.35

Profit percent = 23.5%

questions.q_en: 55. In a certain code language, ‘SPIRIT’ is coded as ‘65’ and ‘DENSE’ is coded as ‘83’. How will ‘LOGICAL’ be coded in that language?
questions.q_hi: 55. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, 'SPIRIT' को '65' और 'DENSE' को '83' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उसी भाषा में 'LOGICAL' को किस प्रकार कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.solution_en:
55.(c)Logic : (Sum of reverse position of letters in alphabet – Number of letters in word)

SPIRIT = 8 + 11 + 18 + 9 + 18 + 7 = 71, number of letters = 6, so 71 – 6 = 65

DENSE = 23 + 22 + 13 + 8 + 22 = 88, number of letters = 5, so 88 – 5 = 83

Similarly, LOGICAL = 15 + 12 + 20 + 18 + 24 + 26 + 15 = 130, number of letters = 7, so 130 – 7 = 123
questions.solution_hi:
55.(c) तर्क: (वर्णमाला में अक्षरों की विपरीत स्थिति का योग – शब्द में अक्षरों की संख्या)

SPIRIT = 8 + 11 + 18 + 9 + 18 + 7 = 71, अक्षरों की संख्या = 6, अतः 71 – 6 = 65

DENSE = 23 + 22 + 13 + 8 + 22 = 88, अक्षरों की संख्या = 5, अतः 88 – 5 = 83

इसी प्रकार, LOGICAL = 15 + 12 + 20 + 18 + 24 + 26 + 15 = 130, अक्षरों की संख्या = 7, अतः 130 – 7 = 123
